sections.title: At a glance
sections.description: Visits and how deep they go: page views, visits, views per visit, bounce rate, visit duration and every product event. Each figure opens beside its change against the previous period.

sections.title: Pages
sections.description: The routes people view, the ones visits start on and the ones they leave from.

sections.title: Goals and events
sections.description: The conversions declared in forge.Analytics, every product event by name, and the records people write through the generated CRUD handlers.

sections.title: Funnels
sections.description: Visit to sign-up to activation, built in, and every forge.Funnel counted by visitor, person or org.

sections.title: Experiments
sections.description: Feature-flag exposures (flag_evaluated, from trackExposure or the OpenFeature hook) and how each variant's people went on to activate. Descriptive, not a significance test; empty until an exposure is recorded.

title: shop: product
description: What people do in the product: visits and page views (cookieless, by the platform's daily visitor hash), the pages visits start and end on, declared goals, every product event, the records written through the generated CRUD handlers, the built-in visit → sign-up → activation funnel, declared funnels and flag exposures. Hosted environments only: a local forge env up has no product_events table.

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: page_viewed events in the range. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix)
SELECT sum(views) AS "Page views" FROM visits

panels.title: Pages
panels.description: Each route's page views, distinct visitor-days, signed-in users, and the visits that started (Entries) and ended (Exits) on it.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
p AS (SELECT Props['route'] AS route, count() AS views, uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS visitors, uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), UserId != '') AS users
      FROM web WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed' GROUP BY route),
en AS (SELECT entry_route AS route, count() AS entries FROM visits WHERE entry_route != '' GROUP BY route),
ex AS (SELECT exit_route AS route, count() AS exits FROM visits WHERE exit_route != '' GROUP BY route)
SELECT p.route AS "Route", p.views AS "Views", p.visitors AS "Visitors", p.users AS "Signed-in users", en.entries AS "Entries", ex.exits AS "Exits"
FROM p LEFT JOIN en ON en.route = p.route LEFT JOIN ex ON ex.route = p.route
ORDER BY "Views" DESC, "Route" LIMIT 50

panels.title: Entry pages
panels.description: Visits by the route they started on: the share that bounced, and the share whose visitor signed up the same day.
panels.sql:

         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,

         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d)
SELECT entry_route AS "Entry page", count() AS "Visits",
       round(100 * avg(views = 1 AND actions = 0), 1) AS "Bounce %",
       round(100 * countIf((EnvId, h) IN (SELECT EnvId, h FROM su_h WHERE h != '')) / count(), 1) AS "Sign-up %"
FROM visits WHERE entry_route != ''
GROUP BY entry_route ORDER BY "Visits" DESC, "Entry page" LIMIT 50

panels.title: Exit pages
panels.description: Visits by the route they ended on, and the exit rate: exits over the route's page views.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
ex AS (SELECT exit_route AS route, count() AS exits FROM visits WHERE exit_route != '' GROUP BY route),
p AS (SELECT Props['route'] AS route, count() AS views FROM web WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed' GROUP BY route)
SELECT ex.route AS "Exit page", ex.exits AS "Exits", round(100 * ex.exits / nullIf(p.views, 0), 1) AS "Exit rate %"
FROM ex LEFT JOIN p ON p.route = ex.route
ORDER BY "Exits" DESC, "Exit page" LIMIT 50

panels.title: Goals
panels.description: One row per goal declared in forge.Analytics: the persons who reached it (a signed-in user, the user a same-day sign-in links a visitor to, else the visitor-day), every time it was reached, and its conversion rate: persons over the range's visitor-days.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
persons AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),
                 e.DayVisitor != '', concat('d:', e.DayVisitor), '') AS person
  FROM (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, EventName, Props, UserId, VisitorId, DayVisitor, Privacy
        FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND ((EventName = 'purchase') OR (EventName = 'page_viewed' AND Props['route'] = '/pricing'))) AS e
  LEFT JOIN stitch AS l ON l.EnvId = e.EnvId AND l.h = e.DayVisitor),
hits AS (SELECT goal, EnvId, person FROM persons ARRAY JOIN arrayFilter(g -> g != '', [if(EventName = 'purchase', 'checkout', ''), if(EventName = 'page_viewed' AND Props['route'] = '/pricing', 'pricing', '')]) AS goal)
SELECT transform(d.goal, ['checkout', 'pricing'], ['Checkout', 'pricing'], d.goal) AS "Goal",
       uniqExactIf((h.EnvId, h.person), h.person != '') AS "Persons",
       countIf(h.goal != '') AS "Total",
       round(100 * uniqExactIf((h.EnvId, h.person), h.person != '') / nullIf((SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, h)) FROM web), 0), 2) AS "Conversion %"
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(['checkout', 'pricing']) AS goal) AS d
LEFT JOIN hits AS h ON h.goal = d.goal
GROUP BY d.goal ORDER BY indexOf(['checkout', 'pricing'], d.goal)

panels.title: Events by name
panels.description: Every product event in the range but page views: how often, by how many persons, and when it was last seen.
panels.sql:
WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
persons AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),
                 e.DayVisitor != '', concat('d:', e.DayVisitor), '') AS person
  FROM (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, EventName, Props, UserId, VisitorId, DayVisitor, Privacy
        FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND EventName NOT IN ('page_viewed', 'auth_accounts')) AS e
  LEFT JOIN stitch AS l ON l.EnvId = e.EnvId AND l.h = e.DayVisitor)
SELECT EventName AS "Event", count() AS "Events", uniqExactIf((EnvId, person), person != '') AS "Persons",
       toDateTime(max(ts), 'UTC') AS "Last seen"
FROM persons GROUP BY EventName ORDER BY "Events" DESC, "Event" LIMIT 50

panels.title: Records written per entity
panels.description: The automatic CRUD product events (creates, updates and deletes together), one colour per entity, stacked: the top edge is every write.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t,
       replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', '') AS entity,
       count() AS records
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
GROUP BY t, entity ORDER BY t

panels.title: Creates, updates and deletes per entity
panels.description: The CRUD mix of each entity in the range: one bar per entity, a colour per action.
panels.sql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', '') AS entity,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_created')) AS "Created",
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_updated')) AS "Updated",
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_deleted')) AS "Deleted"
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
GROUP BY entity ORDER BY count() DESC, entity LIMIT 20

panels.title: Visit → sign-up → activation
panels.description: Visitor-days in the range, the sign-ups of the range (persons; a sign-up with no visit, an API sign-up or one on another device, counts too), and those that reached the first order_created event within 7d of signing up. The first step counts visitor-days, the others persons.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d),
act AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, concat('u:', UserId) AS person, min(Timestamp) AS at
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName = 'order_created' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
SELECT step AS "Step", n AS "Persons"
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS i, 'Visited' AS step, (SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, h)) FROM web) AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'Signed up', (SELECT count() FROM su_h)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'Activated', (SELECT countIf(x.UserId != '' AND x.at >= s.at AND x.at < s.at + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND)
                          FROM su_h AS s LEFT JOIN act AS x ON x.EnvId = s.EnvId AND x.UserId = s.UserId))
ORDER BY i

panels.title: Sign-ups from a visit
panels.description: The share of the range's sign-ups linked to a visit: the sign-up carried a visitor hash, or a same-day sign-in links one to the user. The rest signed up through the API or on another device.
panels.sql:
WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d)
SELECT round(countIf(h != '') / nullIf(count(), 0), 4) AS "From a visit" FROM su_h

panels.title: Buy
panels.description: Product events in order (page_viewed → add_to_cart → purchase), within 1d, counted per person (the signed-in user, else the user a same-day sign-in links a visitor to, else the visitor-day).
panels.sql:
SELECT ['page_viewed', 'add_to_cart', 'purchase'][i] AS "Step", countIf(level >= i) AS "Persons"
FROM (
  SELECT windowFunnel(86400)(toDateTime(ts), EventName = 'page_viewed', EventName = 'add_to_cart', EventName = 'purchase') AS level
  FROM (WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
persons AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),
                 e.DayVisitor != '', concat('d:', e.DayVisitor), '') AS person
  FROM (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, EventName, Props, UserId, VisitorId, DayVisitor, Privacy
        FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND EventName IN ('page_viewed', 'add_to_cart', 'purchase')) AS e
  LEFT JOIN stitch AS l ON l.EnvId = e.EnvId AND l.h = e.DayVisitor)
SELECT EnvId, person AS k, ts, EventName, Props FROM persons WHERE person != '')
  GROUP BY EnvId, k)
ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS i
GROUP BY i ORDER BY i

panels.title: browse
panels.description: Product events in order (page_viewed → add_to_cart), within 1h, counted per visitor-day (the platform's daily visitor hash).
panels.sql:
SELECT ['page_viewed', 'add_to_cart'][i] AS "Step", countIf(level >= i) AS "Visitors"
FROM (
  SELECT windowFunnel(3600)(toDateTime(ts), EventName = 'page_viewed', EventName = 'add_to_cart') AS level
  FROM (SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS k, Timestamp AS ts, EventName, Props FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND EventName IN ('page_viewed', 'add_to_cart'))
  GROUP BY EnvId, k)
ARRAY JOIN range(1, 3) AS i
GROUP BY i ORDER BY i

panels.title: Flag exposures
panels.description: Each flag and variant: the persons exposed in the range, and the share of them whose first the first order_created event came within 7d after their first exposure. Descriptive, not a significance test.
panels.sql:
WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
persons AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),
                 e.DayVisitor != '', concat('d:', e.DayVisitor), '') AS person
  FROM (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, EventName, Props, UserId, VisitorId, DayVisitor, Privacy
        FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND EventName = 'flag_evaluated') AS e
  LEFT JOIN stitch AS l ON l.EnvId = e.EnvId AND l.h = e.DayVisitor),
act AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, concat('u:', UserId) AS person, min(Timestamp) AS at
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName = 'order_created' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId),
x AS (SELECT Props['flag'] AS flag, Props['variant'] AS variant, EnvId, person, min(ts) AS first_at
      FROM persons WHERE person != '' GROUP BY flag, variant, EnvId, person)
SELECT x.flag AS "Flag", x.variant AS "Variant", count() AS "Exposed persons",
       round(100 * countIf(y.UserId != '' AND y.at >= x.first_at AND y.at < x.first_at + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND) / count(), 1) AS "Activated %"
FROM x LEFT JOIN act AS y ON y.EnvId = x.EnvId AND y.person = x.person
GROUP BY x.flag, x.variant ORDER BY "Flag", "Variant"
